# Release Compass

> A community reference and portable Agent Skill for software release terminology.

## Start

- [Overview](README.md): purpose, quick start and scope.
- [Repository instructions](AGENTS.md): guidance for agents working here.
- [Portable skill](.agents/skills/release-compass/SKILL.md): workflow and selective references.
- [Catalog](docs/catalog.md): human-readable definitions and caveats.
- [Agent setup](docs/agents.md): client-specific paths and limitations.

## Structured references

- [Terms](.agents/skills/release-compass/data/terms.json): canonical catalog.
- [Sources](.agents/skills/release-compass/data/sources.json): primary documentation registry.
- [Data contract](docs/data.md): fields, evidence scope and lookup semantics.
